summary: Export open asks and unread updates from the canonical attention publication as bounded daemon metrics

schema.detail: Reads an existing in-memory publication without SQL or schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Additive OTLP gauges only; no client, peer or harness protocol changes.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond a normal daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: The existing configured person bounds metric labels; replicas aggregate with max rather than sum.

recovery.detail: No persistent changes; existing binary rollback remains unchanged.
